manifest.method: Arb acb_dirichlet_zeta_zeros via python-flint (rigorous isolation, Turing method)

notes: Unfolding: x_n = theta(gamma_n)/pi + 1 with the Riemann–Siegel theta asymptotic expansion (long double).
Exact GUE spacing law from the sine-kernel Fredholm determinant (Bornemann Gauss–Legendre Nyström, m=60) with Chebyshev-interpolated derivatives; max |p_GUE - Wigner| ≈ 0.005.
KS p-values assume independent spacings; consecutive zeta spacings are weakly correlated, so they are indicative only.
Montgomery F(alpha) is truncated to pairs with |gamma - gamma'| <= 30 and computed on at most the first 1e5 zeros; the 'diagonal' normalization divides by N instead of (T/2pi) log T.

Berry's semiclassical Sigma^2 uses the diagonal approximation with exact prime powers up to 1e6 and the PNT integral beyond; for the low-height dataset it is averaged over the heights spanned by the data.
Lehmer pairs: Csordas–Smith–Varga statistic Delta < 4/5 evaluated with the available zeros (and their conjugates).
